concept: Crypto bot monitor reference and proposed validation contracts

claims.text: Solana sendTransaction returns the first transaction signature when the RPC accepts the signed transaction, without waiting for confirmation. Its documentation says success does not guarantee processing or confirmation and says the signature can be extracted before submission. (low confidence)

Solana getTransaction looks up a transaction by signature at a requested commitment and returns null when it is not found or not confirmed there. Its documented response includes blockTime, metadata, slot and transaction data, with nullable fields. (low confidence)

Ethereum eth_getTransactionByHash documents transaction hash, sender and nonce, with null block hash/number fields while pending. Its lookup can return null when no transaction is found. (low confidence)
The cited Ethereum log response defines removed as true when a log was removed because of a chain reorganization. The response also carries transaction and block identities. (low confidence)

Bybit’s cited execution-history response documents order and execution identities, execution type/time, quantity, price/value, remaining quantity and fee-related fields when provided. It warns that executions with equal execution times can be sorted ambiguously and gives symbol-specific sequence guidance. (low confidence)

Bybit’s Unified transaction log documents entry identity, time/type, instrument/category, currency, order/trade references, funding, trading fee, cash flow, balance change and cash balance fields. The documented funding sign distinguishes received from paid amounts, while positive trading fees mean expense and negative fees mean rebates. (low confidence)

In Bybit’s cited Unified transaction-log documentation, the fee-rate interpretation depends on the entry type, including settlement funding-rate conventions. USDC perpetual settlement can include funding and session settlement, so the funding and cash-flow fields are distinct. (low confidence)

The cited Prometheus Alertmanager documentation defines inhibition as suppressing notifications for certain alerts when specified other alerts are already firing. It describes silences as time-bounded muting: an incoming alert matching an active silence’s equality or regular-expression matchers receives no notification. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09)

The cited Solana transaction JSON structures describe pre/post native balances and token-balance records including account index, mint and token amount/decimals, with optional owner and program identity. Transaction metadata separately exposes fee and execution-error information. (low confidence)

The historical RFC 2679 explains that source/destination clock synchronization error and clock resolution contribute uncertainty to one-way IP delay measurements. It separately requires accounting for uncertainty between software host timestamps and wire times. (low confidence)

In the cited OAuth Bearer specification, invalid_token includes an expired, revoked, malformed or otherwise invalid access token; insufficient_scope means the request needs greater privileges than the token supplies. These error meanings belong to that authentication scheme. (low confidence)

The cited OAuth Bearer specification says a resource server should omit an error code when a request lacks authentication information, including an unsupported authentication method. Its missing-authentication example differs from the invalid_token error response. (low confidence)

For recent-blockhash expiry checking, the Solana cookbook says to retain lastValidBlockHeight and poll confirmed block height until it exceeds that bound. It treats durable-nonce transaction confirmation separately. (low confidence)

Ethereum eth_getTransactionReceipt is unavailable for a pending transaction and documents block identity, execution status, gas used and effective gas price. Gas used is transaction gas consumption; effective gas price is the paid price per gas unit. (low confidence)
The cited Ethereum eth_sendTransaction documentation says an optional nonce permits overwriting a pending transaction that uses the same nonce. (low confidence)
The cited Bybit execution-history and Unified transaction-log endpoints document time filters and next-page cursors, with different default time windows. (medium confidence)

Bybit’s cited ticker documentation lists mark price, last traded price and index price as separate fields. Its positions response lists mark price and reported position leverage separately. (medium confidence)

Bybit’s cited positions response describes cross-margin liquidation price as estimated and documents an empty liquidation-price value in portfolio margin mode or outside specified price bounds. It also returns an empty leverage field for portfolio margin mode. (low confidence)

Bybit’s cited positions response defines positionIMByMp and positionMMByMp as initial and maintenance margin calculated by mark price. It documents empty values for those fields in portfolio margin mode. (low confidence)
The cited StepSecurity article recommends not putting private keys in environment files for third-party tools and recommends hardware wallets or separate signing services. (low confidence)

Bybit’s cited Unified transaction log defines change = cashFlow + funding - fee and states that cashFlow excludes trading and funding fees. It defines cashBalance as wallet balance after a cash change; this is the documented entry-level cash relation. (low confidence)

The cited Grafana Cloud IRM response documentation says silencing prevents notifications for a specified duration without resolving the issue. While the group is silenced, IRM records source firing and resolve signals but does not act on them. This is notification-handling state, not evidence that the underlying bot has recovered. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09)

CCXT documents switching to an exchange sandbox only if the underlying exchange supports it, immediately after constructing the exchange and before any other call. The manual states that sandbox keys are not interchangeable with production keys. (low confidence)

Within its firm-performance reporting scope, the GIPS handbook requires returns after transaction costs and permits estimated transaction costs only for portfolios whose actual transaction costs are not known. (low confidence)

Evidently’s cited drift documentation requires nonempty reference/current columns and filters empty or infinite values for distribution drift. It says default drift tests do not react to increasing empty counts and recommends separate null-share tests. (low confidence)

narrative.documentConcept: Crypto bot chain execution and valuation contracts
narrative.text: PROPOSED: If designing monitoring, bind candidates to chain/account, signature/hash, nonce or recent-blockhash identity. Retain submission, acknowledgement, lookup, commitment, execution and economic observations separately with RPC/time/block/slot/error/history. Require canonical evidence before selecting replacement winners; preserve expiry/reorg/history uncertainty without blind resubmission. Define landing delay as inclusion-observation minus submission time and progression delay between observed stages, on one clock/inclusion revision. Compare known intent constraints with observed assets/fills/fees separately from success flags. Preserve execution/ledger identities, native signs, windows, cursors and missing fields. Declare valuation bases, account/margin modes and currency units. For risk views, choose only documented, applicable venue-reported leverage, mark, margin and liquidation references; expose missing, stale or estimated inputs. Do not substitute last price for a missing declared mark, invent a global liquidation model, infer safety from a reference value, or treat entry-level cash change as portfolio return. Keep monitoring outside signing authority.

narrative.documentConcept: Crypto bot monitor evidence and latency contracts
narrative.text: PROPOSED: If designing a monitor, choose bot/monitor/account/source/configuration/incident/event identities, distinguishing provider IDs from local ones. Record event E, observation O, processing P and display D with clock domains; define P-O, D-O and justified D-E, otherwise unknown. Preserve conflicts, partial collection and old success as dated history. Choose grouping/deduplication keys and reopening windows. For notification/ACK attempts, retain local request/attempt ID, target, incident/event links, time, response/error and redacted diagnostics; preserve uncertain outcome and reconcile before retrying. Record first relevant observation F, detection I, attempt N, proved receipt R, human ACK A, provider resolution V and recovery verification K separately; define I-F, N-I, R-N, A-I and K-I only for observed comparable endpoints. Do not promote a send/ACK/silence into recovery. For proposed recovery, require fresh current-generation feeds, venue-reconciled orders/fills/positions and current risk observations; declare resume authority. Classify errors through documented mappings, omit secrets and retain unobserved evidence as unknown.

narrative.documentConcept: Crypto bot monitor proposed drill and recovery oracles
narrative.text: PROPOSED: If designing offline drills, retain initial state/intent, build/configuration, ordered observations, identities, source/receive clocks and expected outputs. Remove production credentials/signers; verify interception of every order/sign/send route and fail unexpected attempts. Restore fixtures, install verified isolation/deterministic controls, replay inputs and compare semantic outputs. Define same-clock detection-minus-injection, restoration-minus-detection and total-restoration intervals; leave unobserved endpoints unresolved. Inject staleness, disconnects, gaps, incomplete snapshots, duplicates, reordering and missing times. Require old-success/new-failure visibility, intentional-stop preservation and notification-direction checks through restart. Preserve unknown submissions until sufficient simulated venue evidence, without repeats/duplicate fills. Test cancel/fill and late-snapshot races under declared correction rules. Require sentinel-secret absence from normal/error logs, UI and exports. For financial reference checks, select the published venue/accounting convention, isolate transfers from valuation/trading changes, compare partial-fill fields and document fee signs. Do not re-deduct a cost already reflected in a balance; retain unavailable inputs as unknown.

narrative.documentConcept: Crypto bot performance and drift uncertainty contracts
narrative.text: PROPOSED: If designing performance/drift reporting, declare portfolio/funding boundary, reserves, return algorithm, denominator, linking, flow timing and valuation provenance. Label fills, costs/funding and marks observed, estimated, unavailable or inapplicable; withhold complete-current-net labels for incomplete evidence and never default missing costs to zero. Match input/decision events, clocks, model/training/configuration/build identity and initial account state across comparison arms. Compare prediction differences and action disagreement on matched events; compare execution on common recorded decisions and model changes on fixed inputs under declared execution assumptions. Display signed costs, funding, inventory and external flows separately; preserve interactions and unallocated residuals instead of claiming causality or alpha. Report windows, raw/usable counts, missingness, estimator/test, score meaning, thresholds, null/dependence assumptions and uncertainty. Require method-specific short-sample/resampling justification; withhold unsupported strong conclusions. Report missing/non-finite counts separately from distribution scores; do not universalize product defaults or estimator-specific results.
